enriched_activities.desc: Lie down on bed. Pull blanket over body. Close eyes. Sleep.

enriched_activities.activity: Washing up, brushing teeth, and showering (before Member 2's bathroom slot)
enriched_activities.desc: Wake up. Sit up on bed. Stand up. Walk to bathroom. Open bathroom door. Turn on light. Turn on tap. Adjust water temperature. Step into shower. Wet body. Apply soap. Rub body. Rinse body. Turn off tap. Step out of shower. Pick up towel. Dry body. Pick up toothbrush. Squeeze toothpaste onto toothbrush. Brush teeth. Rinse mouth. Wipe face with towel. Turn off light. Walk out of bathroom. See Member 2. Say 'Bathroom is free'.

enriched_activities.activity: Dressing and packing the work bag
enriched_activities.desc: Walk into bedroom. Open wardrobe. Take out shirt. Put on shirt. Take out pants. Put on pants. Put on socks. Put on shoes. Walk to desk. Pick up work bag. Open work bag. Put notebook in bag. Put pen in bag. Put phone in bag. Put keys in bag. Put wallet in bag. Zip work bag. Check contents.

enriched_activities.activity: Making and eating breakfast with Member 2, boiling water with the kettle and making toast
enriched_activities.desc: Walk to kitchen. Greet Member 2. Say 'Good morning'. Fill kettle with water. Place kettle on base. Press switch. Open bread bag. Take out two slices. Place slices in toaster. Press toaster lever. Wait for toast. Pour hot water into mug. Add tea bag. Stir. Take toast from toaster. Put toast on plate. Spread butter on toast. Sit at table. Eat toast. Drink tea. Talk with Member 2 about work.

enriched_activities.activity: Final check of work bag and getting ready to leave
enriched_activities.desc: Walk to bedroom. Pick up work bag. Open work bag. Check notebook. Check pen. Check phone. Check keys. Check wallet. Zip work bag. Put on jacket. Pick up keys. Walk to door.

Walk out of house. Close door. Lock door. Walk to bus stop. Wait for bus. Board bus. Tap transit card. Find seat. Sit down. Look out window. Get off bus. Walk to office building. Enter building. Walk to desk.

enriched_activities.activity: Working at the community program office, coordinating sessions and answering emails
enriched_activities.desc: Sit at desk. Turn on computer. Open email. Read emails. Reply to emails. Make phone calls. Coordinate sessions: call partners. Schedule meetings. Write notes. Attend meeting. Discuss with colleagues. Update files.

enriched_activities.activity: Taking a lunch break near the office
enriched_activities.desc: Walk to café. Open door. Stand in line. Order sandwich. Pay cashier. Take receipt. Sit at table. Unwrap sandwich. Eat sandwich. Drink water. Wipe mouth. Throw trash. Walk back to office. Enter office.

enriched_activities.activity: Working on community program coordination, meetings, and partner follow-ups
enriched_activities.desc: Sit at desk. Check schedule. Make phone calls. Send emails. Attend meeting. Take notes. Discuss with colleagues. Update files. Open document. Type report. Print document. Walk to printer. Pick up document. Staple pages. File document.
Walk to bus stop. Wait for bus. Board bus. Tap transit card. Find seat. Sit down. Look out window. Get off bus. Walk to house. Open door. Enter house.

enriched_activities.activity: Relaxing on the sofa and watching TV (before Member 2's living room time)
enriched_activities.desc: Walk into living room. Sit on sofa. Pick up remote. Press power button on TV. Press channel up button. Press volume up button. Put down remote. Watch TV. Pick up phone. Press power button. Look at screen. Swipe screen. Put down phone. Lean back on sofa. Watch TV.

enriched_activities.activity: Cooking and eating dinner (after Member 2 finishes in the kitchen)
enriched_activities.desc: Walk to kitchen. Open refrigerator. Take out vegetables. Take out meat. Place on counter. Turn on induction cooker. Place pan on cooker. Add oil. Chop vegetables. Add vegetables to pan. Stir. Add meat. Stir. Add spices. Turn off cooker. Put food on plate. Sit at table. Eat dinner. Drink water. Pick up plate. Walk to sink. Rinse plate. Place plate in dishwasher.

enriched_activities.activity: Vacuuming and tidying up the living area
enriched_activities.desc: Walk to living room. Pick up vacuum cleaner. Plug in vacuum cleaner. Turn on vacuum cleaner. Vacuum floor. Move sofa. Vacuum under sofa. Move coffee table. Vacuum under coffee table. Turn off vacuum cleaner. Unplug vacuum cleaner. Put away vacuum cleaner. Pick up magazines. Put magazines on shelf. Fluff pillows.

enriched_activities.activity: Using the computer at the desk for personal tasks
enriched_activities.desc: Walk to bedroom. Sit at desk. Turn on desk lamp. Press power button on computer. Wait for boot. Move mouse. Click on browser icon. Type website address. Press enter. Scroll through page. Type comment. Press enter. Open game. Click play. Use keyboard. Use mouse. Click on game. Close game. Turn off computer. Turn off desk lamp.

enriched_activities.activity: Showering and getting ready for bed (before Member 2's evening bathroom slot)
enriched_activities.desc: Walk to bathroom. Turn on light. Turn on tap. Adjust water temperature. Step into shower. Wet body. Apply soap. Rub body. Rinse body. Turn off tap. Step out. Pick up towel. Dry body. Put on pajamas. Brush teeth. Rinse mouth. Turn off light. Walk out.

enriched_activities.activity: Reading and winding down, checking phone
enriched_activities.desc: Walk to bedroom. Sit on bed. Pick up book. Open to bookmark. Read pages. Turn page. Read pages. Turn page. Put down book. Pick up phone. Press power button. Look at screen. Swipe screen. Type message. Press send. Put down phone. Turn off desk lamp. Lie down. Pull blanket over body.
Lie in bed. Close eyes. Sleep.
